description: Zenodo publishes a ZIP archive supporting the mapped inventory of 8,349 landslide relics in the northern Taihang Mountains of China. The article describes interpretation of high-resolution imagery and comparison with elevation, slope, aspect, curvature, river and fault distance, lithology and land cover. The resolving repository page lists a versioned archive under CC BY 4.0, free to obtain. The data can train or test landslide exposure models for roads, settlements and power lines in this mountain region. Relics show past terrain change, not the date or probability of a future slide. Small or visually faint landslides may have been missed; the article explicitly describes that limitation. The repository summary does not document internal file formats, coordinates or the observation date of every relic, so the ZIP must be inspected before spatial joins. This resource complements data-meteor-nepal-landslide-hazard-maps as a separate mapped mountain-landslide source. No archive was downloaded. It supports simulation of landslide exposure near mountain infrastructure.
